items.question: What is the shortest validity period offered for the UAE jobseeker visit visa?
items.fact: Jobseeker visit visa validity options are 60, 90, or 120 days.

items.question: Do job seekers have to pay a licensed recruitment agency in the UAE to find a job?
items.gold: No, job seekers are not required to pay any recruitment agency; employers bear those fees.
items.fact: Job seekers pay no fees to recruitment agencies; employers do.
